meta_title: Green Leaf Lawns & Landscapes | Landscape Gardener Newcastle
meta_description: Green Leaf Lawns & Landscapes brings professional garden design and maintenance to Newcastle. Bespoke landscaping, lawn care, and planting services. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: Expert landscape gardening that turns overgrown plots and tired lawns into outdoor spaces you'll love spending time in.
services_heading: Complete Landscape Gardening Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From routine lawn maintenance to full garden redesigns, we handle every aspect of outdoor space creation and care.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts tailored to your vision, budget, and Newcastle's climate. We create detailed plans before any work begins, so you know exactly what to expect.

services.title: Lawn Installation & Renovation
services.desc: New turf laid professionally, or tired grass rescued with aeration, scarification, and specialist feeding. Healthy, lush lawns in weeks, not months.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Seasonal planting schemes and year-round colour combinations chosen for Newcastle's growing conditions. Herbaceous borders, shrub beds, and feature plantings that thrive.

services.title: Paving, Decking & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professional installation of patios, block paving, decking, and garden edging. Sturdy, attractive outdoor living areas built to last.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Work
services.desc: Pruning, shaping, and selective felling carried out safely and to professional standards. We tidy overgrown trees and improve light without damaging your garden's structure.

services.title: Ongoing Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly visits for mowing, weeding, deadheading, and seasonal tidy-ups. Keep your garden looking showroom-ready year-round.

about_pullquote: Every garden tells a story. We help yours tell the right one.
about_para_1: Green Leaf Lawns & Landscapes was founded 15 years ago by a team of horticultural specialists frustrated with the shortage of trustworthy, skilled garden professionals in the North East. What started as a two-person operation has grown into Newcastle's go-to choice for landscape gardening, with a track record of over 1,200 completed projects ranging from small residential makeovers to substantial commercial grounds.
about_para_2: We believe in listening first and designing second. Every project begins with a free consultation where we understand your goals, soil conditions, and budget. Our repeat customer rate sits at 67%, because people return to us for maintenance once they've seen what proper care does for their outdoor space. We're insured, reliable, and proud of the way we leave every site.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had an absolute jungle of a back garden that we didn't know where to start with. Green Leaf came out, listened to what we wanted, and drew up a plan that was exactly what we'd imagined but somehow better. The lads were tidy, professional, and finished bang on schedule. Garden is now the heart of our home. Couldn't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Been using Green Leaf for regular maintenance for three years now. They come fortnightly, keep the lawn pristine, and actually know what they're talking about when it comes to plants. Prices are fair and they always turn up when they say they will. That's rare these days.
reviews.author: Ellen P.

reviews.text: Wanted a new patio and some raised beds. Got a free design from Green Leaf, accepted the quote, and they completed everything in five days with minimal fuss. Quality of the work is exceptional and the garden looks completely different now. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David W.
